name: 70582 · St Martinvlle, LA
findings: ZIP 70582 (St Martinvlle) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70582 (St Martinvlle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
